race.title: Join The Midnite Movement Apprentice Handicap
race.verdict: JUNKYARD DOG can make amends for a near miss at Newcastle last month with Cara Tuke taking a useful 7 lb off. Fram Castle and Sycamore Gap are closely matched on recent efforts over 1¾m here and head the dangers along with Jack Langley . JUNKYARD DOG (IRE) FRAM CASTLE (IRE) SYCAMORE GAP
race.bettingForecast: Junkyard Dog (3/1), Fram Castle (4/1), Sisterandbrother (9/2), Sycamore Gap (6/1), Jack Langley (7/1), Trapper John (12/1), Dollar's Dream (14/1), Beggarman (16/1), New Bay Star (16/1), Damzon (20/1)
